identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Pembrolizumab (MK-3475) Versus Paclitaxel for Participants With Advanced Gastric/Gastroesophageal Junction Adenocarcinoma That Progressed After Therapy With Platinum and Fluoropyrimidine (MK-3475-061/KEYNOTE-061)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III, Randomized, Open-label Clinical Trial of Pembrolizumab (MK-3475) Versus Paclitaxel in Subjects With Advanced Gastric or Gastroesophageal Junction Adenocarcinoma Who Progressed After First-Line Therapy With Platinum and Fluoropyrimidine

armGroups.label: Pembrolizumab
armGroups.description: Participants receive 200 mg intravenous (IV) pembrolizumab on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle, for up to 35 administrations (approximately 2 years).

armGroups.label: Paclitaxel
armGroups.description: Participants receive 80 mg/m\^2 IV paclitaxel on Days 1, 8, and 15 of each 28-day cycle, until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

interventions.name: pembrolizumab
interventions.description: 200 mg administered as IV infusion on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle.

interventions.name: paclitaxel
interventions.description: 80 mg/m\^2 administered as IV infusion on Days 1, 8, and 15 of each 28-day cycle.
